summary: Validated the new Contabilidad (Accounting) module end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passing in /app/backend/tests/test_accounting.py covering cash balance, cash_in, cash_out, insufficient-balance 400 validation, RBAC (cliente -> 403), transaction creation + MAD->EUR conversion (0.092), invalid type / short description Pydantic validation, list with filters + pagination shape, summary structure, payroll structure, CSV export Content-Type and headers. Frontend (admin login -> /nubo-private-control-badr/panel -> sidebar 'admin-nav-accounting'): contabilidad-section renders, topbar title = 'Contabilidad', 4 BalanceCards (Caja MAD, Caja EUR, Ingresos netos EUR, Balance neto MAD) display, transactions-card + payroll-card render. E2E cash flow: cash-in 800 MAD updates MAD card 0->800 and creates row '+ 800 MAD'; cash-out 200 MAD updates to 600 MAD; cash-out 99999 MAD shows toast 'Saldo insuficiente en caja MAD: disponible 600.0, solicitado 99999.0' and DOES NOT create a row. txn-filter-type='cash_in' filters to only 'Entrada caja' rows. export-txns-btn triggers download of 'transacciones.csv'. Payroll table shows 1 entry (Test Driver, 4 entregas, 9.75 EUR / 105.98 MAD, Pendiente).

issues: Topbar 'Actualizar' button at right is generic and not wired to refresh the accounting section specifically (it likely refreshes parent dashboard). Not blocking — the section refetches on tab change. Optional: add a section-specific refresh button or wire the topbar refresh to fetchAll().

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/accounting/*: clean separation, Pydantic v2 models (AcctTxnCreate, AcctCashMovement) with proper Field(gt=0, min_length=2) validation. MAD->EUR conversion (0.092) centralized in _acct_amount_eur. Mongo _id excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in all reads — good.

Cash balance is computed by scanning all cash_mad/cash_eur transactions on every call. For low volume preview this is fine; for production-scale (>50k txns) consider an aggregated counter or pre-computed balance doc.

acct_cash_out uses HTTPException 400 with descriptive Spanish detail and properly checks against live balance via acct_cash_balance() — race condition possible under concurrency (two parallel cash_outs could both pass the check). For real deployments, wrap in a Mongo transaction or use atomic findAndModify on a balance counter document.

acct_payroll reuses _compute_earnings on delivered orders — depends on DEFAULT_COMMISSION_RATE and is_paid mapping via driver_payouts. Verified entry shape (courier_id, courier_name, total_deliveries, net_amount_eur, net_amount_mad, is_paid). gross_revenue_eur is included as bonus (not in spec but useful).

acct_export_transactions: CSV header matches spec exactly ['fecha','tipo','importe','moneda','importe_eur','metodo','descripcion','referencia','creado_por']. Content-Type 'text/csv; charset=utf-8' set with a unique filename containing UTC timestamp.

ContabilidadSection.jsx: clean structure, all required data-testids present (contabilidad-section, cash-in-btn, cash-out-btn, export-txns-btn, txn-filter-type, transactions-card, payroll-card, cash-dialog, cash-amount, cash-currency, cash-description, cash-submit, txn-row-<id>, payroll-row-<id>). Loading/error states handled via toast. fetchAll re-runs on filterType change via useEffect.

Minor: exportCsv first calls window.open(url?token=...) (which the backend ignores — token is only read from Authorization header, so the popup will return 403 silently) and then falls back to axios blob download. The popup is unnecessary noise; recommend removing the window.open line and keeping only the axios+blob path. Currently it does work (download triggered as 'transacciones.csv') so this is cosmetic.

SidebarAdmin + AdminLayout integration: 'admin-nav-accounting' nav item present, AdminLayout title map includes 'accounting' -> 'Contabilidad'. AdminDashboard wraps ContabilidadSection in a `hidden` section so state is preserved across tab switches (consistent with the rest of the panel).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, sidebar nav, balance cards, cash-in, cash-out, overdraft validation, filter, CSV export, payroll render)
